title: Convoy: Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose common Convoy failures by shrinking the loop and testing one fix.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: If convoys keep failing, shorten the run, reduce cargo value, pre-place supplies, and solve the worst hazard before increasing distance.

blocks.title: Reset The Loop
blocks.body: If convoy runs fail repeatedly, shrink the cargo, shorten the route, add a staging stop, and solve the incident that appears most often.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Change one variable, run a smaller test, and compare the result. Fixing three things at once can hide the part that actually mattered.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
